name: Cybersecurity Governance
description: Establish and maintain a cybersecurity governance framework.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm cybersecurity governance framework.

partial_if.detail: Risk data exists but governance framework not formally documented.

remediation: Establish a cybersecurity governance framework aligned with SAMA CSF.

name: Cybersecurity Risk Management
description: Implement a formal cyber risk management process.

compliant_if.detail: Risk register confirms risk management process.

partial_if.detail: Governance exists but no formal risk register.

remediation: Implement a formal cyber risk management process with regular risk assessments.

name: Cybersecurity Compliance
description: Establish compliance monitoring covering regulatory requirements.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and risk data confirm compliance monitoring.

remediation: Establish compliance monitoring covering SAMA, NCA, and relevant regulations.

name: Asset Management
description: Identify, classify, and inventory all information assets.
remediation: Maintain a complete asset inventory with classification and ownership.

name: Identity and Access Management
description: Implement IAM controls for banking systems.

compliant_if.detail: Employee and network records confirm IAM controls.

remediation: Implement IAM with MFA for all critical banking systems.

name: Application Security
description: Implement application security controls for banking applications.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and governance records confirm application security.

remediation: Implement SDLC security. Perform code reviews and penetration testing.

name: Network Security Management
description: Implement network security controls including firewalls and segmentation.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules with segmentation confirm network security.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but segmentation incomplete.

remediation: Deploy firewalls, IDS/IPS, and network segmentation for banking infrastructure.

name: Security Event Monitoring
description: Implement logging and monitoring for security event detection.

partial_if.detail: Risk data exists but monitoring not formally documented.

remediation: Implement SIEM aligned to SAMA detection requirements. Enable 24/7 SOC.

name: Third-Party Cybersecurity

compliant_if.detail: Vendor records confirm third-party risk tracking.

remediation: Establish a third-party risk management programme with vendor assessments.

name: Incident and Threat Management
description: Document and test cyber incident response procedures.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm incident response procedures.

partial_if.detail: Risk data exists but incident procedures not documented.

remediation: Document and test cyber incident response and crisis management procedures.

name: Cybersecurity Awareness
description: Implement cybersecurity awareness training for all staff.

compliant_if.detail: Employee training records confirm awareness programme.

partial_if.detail: Employees exist but training records incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No employee records for training verification.

remediation: Implement mandatory cybersecurity awareness training for all employees.

name: Business Continuity Management

compliant_if.detail: Governance and risk data confirm BCP/DR procedures.

remediation: Establish and regularly test BCP/DR procedures for all critical banking services.
